title: The Tryouts of the band room
author: Ansel Whitlock
blurb: Mara Voss, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
